item: Missing-seats problem in the large hall
evidence: Auditorium 4 (Screen 4 — Luxe Recliner Lounge) verified: all 512 seats accurately generated via curved_flagship arc projection without bounding box truncation.
CameraController.tsx limits seated head-look yaw to ±80° (±1.396 rad) and pitch to ±35° (±0.611 rad); WalkHUD.tsx implements collision boundary clamping.
